name: slow
description: A slow first token and a long, slow reply: for testing Stop, reload and a second tab.
title: A slow answer

steps.text: This answer arrives slowly on purpose, a few letters at a time, so there is plenty of time to press Stop, to reload the page, or to open the same chat in another tab and watch it there. It keeps going for a while longer, sentence after sentence, long enough that stopping or restarting the server catches it in the middle, which is exactly the moment worth testing. Almost done now; just a few more words, and then it will finally end here, in another tab too.
